_documentation.purpose: All possible character titles. A player only sees IDs listed in character.unlockedTitles.
_documentation.display_rule: The UI wraps the selected title name in quotes when shown beside the character name.

beginner.name: Freshman
beginner.description: Given to every new hero who first steps into the tower.

ember_scribe.name: Ember Scribe
ember_scribe.description: A title for players who master fire words.

frostbound.name: Frostbound
frostbound.description: A title for players who survive the winter trials.

glassbreaker.name: Glassbreaker
glassbreaker.description: A title for players who help defeat a world event boss.

relic_seeker.name: Relic Seeker
relic_seeker.description: A title for players who collect rare relics.

towerbound.name: Towerbound
towerbound.description: A title for players who push deep into the ascension tower.

veilwalker.name: Veilwalker
veilwalker.description: A title for players who thrive when the veil thins.

cursed_quill.name: Cursed Quill
cursed_quill.description: A title for players who endure cursed day modifiers.
